scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, and value proposition prominently to communicate MirDB's unique value within 5 seconds of page load

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage URL
steps.context: User arrives from search engine or direct link

steps.description: Check that the hero section is immediately visible above the fold without scrolling
steps.context: First impression within 5 seconds per US-1

steps.description: Confirm product name 'MirDB' and logo are prominently displayed
steps.context: REQ-1 requirement for product name display

steps.description: Check that a clear tagline communicating persistence + memcached compatibility is visible
steps.context: Expected tagline: 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' or similar

steps.description: Confirm 2-3 bullet points highlighting key differentiators are displayed
steps.context: Per PRD: memcached compatible, persistent storage, Rust-powered

steps.description: Check presence of primary 'Get Started' button and secondary 'View on GitHub' link

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section DOM
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains h1 element with 'MirDB' text

test_cases.input: Query for tagline element in hero section
test_cases.expected: Tagline contains keywords: 'persistent', 'key-value', 'memcached'
At least 2 bullet points or feature highlights are present in hero

test_cases.input: Query for Get Started CTA button
test_cases.expected: Button with text 'Get Started' or similar is present and visible
Link to GitHub repository is present in hero section
Core content visible even with JS disabled (static HTML)

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section presents key capabilities with clear descriptions including persistence, memcached compatibility, and LSM architecture

steps.description: Scroll down from hero to locate the features section
steps.context: User exploring product capabilities per US-2

steps.description: Check that features are displayed in card-based layout
Confirm presence of feature describing memcached protocol support
steps.context: Key differentiator: drop-in replacement for existing clients

steps.description: Confirm presence of feature describing persistent storage via SSTable
Confirm presence of feature describing LSM tree architecture
steps.context: Key differentiator: efficient writes with background compaction

steps.description: Check for feature describing Tokio-based async performance

test_cases.expected: Section with id 'features' or appropriate aria-label exists

test_cases.input: Count feature cards in features section
test_cases.expected: At least 3 feature cards are present (minimum per US-2)
Text contains 'memcached' and 'compatible' or 'protocol'
Text contains 'persistent' or 'persistence' and 'storage' or 'SSTable'
Text contains 'LSM' and 'architecture' or 'tree'

test_cases.input: Verify each feature card has title and description
test_cases.expected: Each card contains heading element and paragraph/description text

steps.context: REQ-10: code snippets with syntax highlighting

steps.description: Check for example commands demonstrating basic operations
Check that code blocks have copy-to-clipboard functionality

test_cases.input: Query DOM for getting started section
test_cases.expected: Section with 'getting started' heading or id exists

test_cases.input: Count code block elements in getting started section
test_cases.expected: At least 2 code blocks present (install + usage)

Example showing how to connect to MirDB (telnet, client library, etc.)
Examples demonstrating basic SET and GET commands

test_cases.expected: Code elements have highlighting classes (Prism.js or similar)

test_cases.input: Test copy button functionality on code block
